name: سوگ از دست دادن حیوان خانگی
description: Someone grieving a dead dog, an empty house after losing a cat, and being told it was just an animal. Verifies all three Persian phrasings stay on pet_loss/grief with real acknowledgment instead of a dismissive reply.

turns.text: سگم مرد و نمی‌تونم جلوی گریه‌م رو بگیرم
گربه‌م رو از دست دادم و خونه خالیه
همه می‌گن فقط یه حیوون بود ولی من خیلی عزادارم

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1 opens the pet_loss thread for a dog's death. Turn 2 stays on pet_loss for the empty house. Turn 3 keeps the dismissal-fighting grief on pet_loss.
expected.behavior: Persian pet-loss grief is acknowledged as real: «فقط یه حیوون بود» is never echoed dismissively and the conversation stays on the grief thread.
